sources: recreation.gov search API for 'Robbers Roost' (facility 241269, reservable false; its campground page returns 404), 2026-10-28

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/robbers-roost-campground ('Single Site: $29 per night'; last updated September 14, 2026) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Sulphur RD Campground Status: Robbers Roost | 11 | 25' | First-come, first-served | $29 | June 5 - Sept 7), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 11 non-electric sites for tents, trailers and RVs; each has a tent pad, fire grate and table. RVs, trailers and other vehicles must fit on the parking spur; no off-road driving or parking. Up to 8 people a site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/robbers-roost-campground ('There are 11 non-electric sites that will accommodate tents, trailers and RVs'; 'RVs, trailers and other vehicles must fit on the parking spur ... Maximum Vehicle Length: 25''; 'A single site may hold up to eight people') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Max Spur 25'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: No drinking water; the nearest is at Idlewild Campground, 5.5 miles away. Trash service.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/robbers-roost-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is not available at this site.'; 'Additional facilities included restrooms and trash service. Water is available at the Idlewild Campground 5.5 miles away.'), read 2026-10-28

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Sulphur Ranger District Campground Status, Operating Season: 'June 5 - Sept 7'), read 2026-10-28

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/robbers-roost-campground ('First come, first served campground.') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Reservations: 'First-come, first-served'), read 2026-10-28

note: Arapaho NF (Sulphur RD) campground in the trees beside US-40 and the headwaters of the Fraser River, ~9,800 ft at the base of Berthoud Pass, five miles south of Winter Park; some sloped sites. --Claude
summary: FS page + ARP Campground Status table: confirmed 11 sites, $29, vault toilets, no drinking water, first-come only. Added max vehicle length 25 ft, season June 5 - Sept 7, fees checked 2026, water-at-Idlewild note. Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Phone missing: Sulphur Ranger District 970-295-6600 (ARP offices page; the campground is listed under the Sulphur RD on its page and in the Campground Status table). Not the Clear Creek RD.

Dead link in website: https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/241269 returns 404 (recreation.gov's search still lists facility 241269 as not reservable). Keep only the FS page https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/robbers-roost-campground.

Length: 25 ft maximum (FS page 'Maximum Vehicle Length: 25'' and the Campground Status table's Max Spur 25'), above the 23-ft line; the 'some sloped sites' remark has no agency source but nothing contradicts it.

Waterfront 'not waterfront' kept: the FS says it 'is located next to Hwy 40 and the Fraser River'; on Esri imagery the Fraser here is a narrow headwater creek in the open meadow west of the loop, ~30-80 m from the pads through trees, with no pad on the bank.

Pin 39.8309,-105.7566 sits inside the campground loop on imagery (OK). The FS page's coordinates (39.8336,-105.7556) are ~300 m NE in unbroken forest; recreation.gov's facility point (39.8325,-105.7573) is the US-40 entrance.
Status: no closure listed; past the June 5 - Sept 7 operating season.
